reply.text:
Panicking when you go over is worth taking seriously, and training can't fix it. That's a relationship with food, and it's one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help you in a way I can't.

Training is a good thing to have in your life, but it works best when it isn't used to make up for what you ate. I'm glad to keep helping with the training side, like consistency, getting stronger, or how your week is set up, whenever you want to dig into that.
